ref27/System/Applications/Utilities/System Information.app/Contents/Resources/Base.lproj/SPApp.nib (menus: Show System Report, Refresh Information, Show Less Information, Send to Apple, Speak Serial Number, Develop, Find)

ref27/System/Applications/Utilities/System Information.app/Contents/Resources/Base.lproj/SPWindow.nib (outline sidebar, item list, item detail, Preparing system profile sheet, Privacy Agreement panel)

features.apple: sidebar group of every hardware class (ATA, Audio, Bluetooth, Camera, Card Reader, Controller, Diagnostics, Disc Burning, Ethernet, Fibre Channel, Graphics/Displays, Memory, NVMe, PCI, Power, Printers, SAS, SATA, Storage, Thunderbolt, USB)
features.note: Every class but ATA has a page: Card Reader, Controller, SAS, Fibre Channel, Disc Burning and Diagnostics (0.6.0) with a reader in probe.rs. ATA is missing: Linux lists parallel and serial ATA ports in the same ata_port class with no field that tells them apart. Check the new pages on a machine that has the device.
features.wire: Add ATA once a sysfs field separates parallel ATA ports from SATA ones (or a host driver name rule is agreed), with a reader in probe.rs and a Category variant in model.rs. Then check the Audio, Bluetooth, Camera, Printers, Thunderbolt, NVMe and SATA pages on a machine that has the device.

features.apple: Network group: Firewall, Locations, Volumes, WWAN, Wi-Fi
features.note: Locations and the firewall's rule state are not built: the OS keeps no network locations an app can read, and the rules need administrator rights. Check Wi-Fi, Ethernet, WWAN and Volumes on Midget.
features.wire: Add Locations (network profiles) once the OS keeps them, and rule state on the Firewall page once a firewall service exists (the page shows the loaded packet filter only). Check Wi-Fi, Ethernet, WWAN and Volumes on Midget.

features.apple: Software group: Accessibility, Applications, Developer, Extensions, Fonts, Frameworks, Installations, Language & Region, Logs, Preference Panes, Printer Software, Profiles, Startup Items, Sync Services
features.note: Installations (the pacman log) and Printer Software (installed PPD drivers) added in 0.6.0. Preference Panes, Accessibility, Developer, Frameworks, Profiles and Sync Services are not built: the shell keeps no pane list and the system has no profile or sync service to read. Check Fonts and Logs on Midget.
features.wire: Add Preference Panes (the pane list lives in the shell), Accessibility, Developer, Frameworks, Installations, Profiles, Printer Software and Sync Services. Check Fonts and Logs on Midget.

features.apple: SPOutlineView with disclosure triangles
features.note: built on parity/team-d-system-information; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Check on Midget: fold a section, relaunch and see it stay folded, drag the sidebar to scroll it; then promote to parity.

features.feature: Item list above an item detail pane
features.apple: split view: Contents list on top, details pane below
features.note: Name and Details headers sort the list (a second click reverses it), and the picked item stays picked through a sort and a refresh. The USB tree keeps bus order. Check the split on Midget.
features.wire: Add column headers and sorting to the item list, and keep the picked item across a refresh. Check the split on Midget.

features.apple: item detail rows
features.note: Key column and value column, scrolls with wheel, drag and arrow keys.

features.apple: first sidebar item Hardware Overview: model, chip, memory, serial, firmware, OS
features.note: Model, vendor, form factor, processor, memory, graphics, serial, operating system, kernel and firmware.

features.apple: Hardware > Processor / chip: cores, cache, speed
features.note: Each processor's clock (cpufreq) and the performance and efficiency core counts (hybrid and capacity-based) are in place (0.6.0). Check on Midget.
features.wire: The clock of each processor (cpufreq) and the performance and efficiency core split are in place (model.rs processor_rows). Physical cores, cache sizes and the clock range are in place; check on Midget.

features.apple: Hardware > Memory: type, speed, slots, manufacturer
features.note: Available memory, swap and the slot list are in place. The slots come from the firmware table, which only root can read; a normal user sees the slots as not reported. Check on Midget.
features.wire: The firmware table (/sys/firmware/dmi/tables/DMI) is readable by root only. The privileged helper runs only the disk requests in springboard/core/src/disk_request.rs, so a read-only DMI request has to be added to that contract and the helper first. Available memory and swap are in place; check on Midget.

features.apple: Graphics/Displays: chipset, VRAM, resolution
features.note: Each display's refresh rate and scale come from the display service (0.6.0). Video memory is in place; check it on a machine with a discrete GPU.
features.wire: Add the refresh rate and scale of each display (needs the shell display service, not sysfs). Video memory is in place; check it on a machine with a discrete GPU.

features.apple: Hardware > PCI
features.note: Address, vendor, class and driver per device.

features.apple: Hardware > USB: bus tree with speed, vendor, power
features.note: built on parity/team-d-system-information; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Check the tree and the maximum power on Midget with a hub attached, then promote to parity.

features.apple: Hardware > Power: battery cycle count, condition, charger
features.note: Source kind, capacity, status, health percentage and cycle count.

features.apple: Hardware > Storage / Volumes: capacity, free space, file system, SMART
features.note: SMART health is still missing: no SMART reader exists in the shell, the disk helper or this app. File system, mount point and free space per partition are in place. Check on Midget.
features.wire: Add SMART health. A smartctl summary needs root, and the privileged helper runs only the disk requests in springboard/core/src/disk_request.rs, so a read-only SMART request has to be added there first (Disk Utility already runs smartctl -H itself, springboard/apps/diskutil-desktop/src/probe.rs:1). File system, mount point and free space per partition are in place.

features.apple: Network > Wi-Fi / Ethernet: addresses, MAC, state
features.note: Wi-Fi SSID and channel are still missing. The network service (netd) publishes the SSID in its Status event, but no app-facing SDK network module exists, and the Status carries no channel. IPv4 addresses, gateway, DNS, link speed and signal are in place.
features.wire: Add a network module to the SDK that reads netd's Status event (springboard/docs/services.md:49) and show the SSID. The channel is not in the event; it needs a netd field first. IPv4 addresses, gateway, DNS, link speed and signal are in place.

features.apple: Software > System / About: version, build, boot volume, uptime
features.note: built on parity/team-d-system-information; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Check the build and secure boot rows on Midget (UEFI and legacy boot), then promote to parity.

features.apple: Software > Applications: name, version, source, 64-bit, last modified
features.note: Signature state is still missing: installs verify a SHA-256 only, so there is no signature to show. Name, kind and install date are in place.
features.wire: Show the signature state once packages carry signatures (installs verify a SHA-256 only). Name, kind and install date are in place.

features.feature: Audio, Bluetooth, Camera, Printers, Thunderbolt hardware pages
features.apple: one page per hardware class
features.note: built on parity/team-d-system-information; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Check each page on a machine that has the device (sound card, Bluetooth controller, camera, printer, Thunderbolt port) and promote to parity.

features.apple: File/View > Refresh Information (cmd+R)
features.note: View > Refresh Information (Cmd+R) is declared in the View menu and calls SysInfo::refresh, which reads the machine again; the toolbar button stays. Check on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget that Cmd+R reads the machine again while a sheet is not open, and that the toolbar button does the same.

features.apple: progress sheet with Cancel while the profile loads
features.note: built on parity/team-d-system-information; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Check on Midget that the sheet shows during a slow read and that Cancel and Escape work, then promote to parity.

features.apple: View > Show Less Information (hides item detail or developer rows)
features.note: View > Show Less Information toggles a mini mode: sidebar and report keep only the Overview.
features.wire: Check on Midget that View > Show Less Information (a check mark while on) leaves only the Overview in the sidebar and the report, and that toggling it back restores every category. The flag is SysInfo::mini (springboard/apps/sysinfo-desktop/src/window.rs:223).

features.feature: Save System Report as .spx / text / rich text
features.apple: File > Save; document types spx, txt, rtf
features.note: Text, rich text and JSON reports are written. A .spx report is not: the reference format has no writer here. Check the three files on Midget.
features.wire: The reference .spx type has no equivalent here: text, rich text and JSON reports are written. Check the three files on Midget.

features.feature: Open a saved system report and Open Recent
features.apple: File > Open, Open Recent; spreporter and spx types
features.note: File > Open Report and Open Recent are in place. The manifest declares public.json at rank none (0.7.0), so Open With lists System Information for a JSON report; Files never picks it by itself, and the report's own type is not registered. Check on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget that Files' Open With lists System Information for a saved report and that the report opens. A dedicated report type would need a UTI in springboard/ui/src/uttype.rs.

features.apple: Edit > Find: Find Next/Previous, Use Selection for Find, Jump to Selection
features.note: Use Selection for Find (Cmd+E) and Jump to Selection (Cmd+J) are in the Edit menu (0.6.0). Typing into the toolbar field is checked on Midget.
features.wire: Check typing into the toolbar field on Midget; add Use Selection for Find and Jump to Selection.

features.apple: Edit > Select All, Copy
features.note: Copy of a picked row or the picked list item is in place. Range selection needs modifier state, and the SDK's Input::Touch and KeyInput carry none yet (springboard/sdk/src/runtime.rs:20).
features.wire: Add the modifier state to Input::Touch and to the key input in the SDK, then range selection (Shift-click and Shift with the arrow keys) here. Copy of a picked row or the picked list item is in place.

features.apple: File > Send to Apple with privacy agreement panel
features.note: Uploads a profile to the vendor; BifrOSt has no such service.

features.apple: Window/Hardware > Speak Serial Number
features.note: Speak Serial Number reads the serial digit by digit through espeak-ng or espeak, with the screen reader on or off (0.7.0). With no engine installed the text shows as the banner. Check the voice on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget that the serial is spoken with the screen reader off, and that the banner shows when no engine is installed.

features.feature: Develop menu: fill startup disk and memory thresholds
features.apple: Develop > Fill Startup Disk, 100 MB below/above warning and danger thresholds
features.note: Developer test tooling for low-disk handling, hidden behind a toggle.

features.apple: arrow keys move the sidebar selection
features.note: built on parity/team-d-system-information; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Check Tab and the arrow keys on Midget across sidebar, item list and card, then promote to parity.

features.apple: item list and item detail with AXHelp text
features.note: Toolbar, sidebar rows and detail card are published controls and tappable through Activate.

features.apple: About, Hide, Hide Others, Show All, Services, Quit, Minimize, Bring All to Front
features.note: The Window menu has Show Overview, Previous Category and Next Category. The application menu is built by the shell, so an app cannot add to it. Check on Midget.
features.wire: The application menu (About, Hide, Quit) is built by the shell and an app cannot add to it; the Window menu has Show Overview, Previous Category and Next Category. Check on Midget.

features.apple: System Information Help
features.note: Help > System Information Help shows a short help card in the window, tested in help.rs; Help > System Information Online Help opens the web page. There is no shell help viewer, so the help is a card, not a separate page; check it on Midget.
